name: pdt
description: Turn any script into a scheduled job in your cloud. pdt builds, runs, and deploys scheduled jobs to AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or Windows Task Scheduler. No servers to run and nothing extra to install, and everything it makes lives in your own account.

interface.longDescription: Turn any script into a scheduled job in your cloud. pdt builds, runs, and deploys scheduled jobs to AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or Windows Task Scheduler. Bring your scripts, deploy with one command, and see the plan and a monthly cost estimate before anything changes. Health checks, logs, and alerts tell you when a job breaks. No servers to run and nothing extra to install, and everything it makes lives in your own account.
interface.defaultPrompt: Turn my script into a scheduled job in my cloud.
